verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only Excel/Sheets add-ins, a Slack-tagged agent, dashboards and no-code connectors. Nothing documents a command-line tool, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
